flags.why: The amorous or womanising sense remains in contemporary use, so dated is misleading ([usage source](https://chuthapdoquangninh.org.vn/phong-luu-la-gi/)).
The verb meaning to call or alert someone is the ordinary modern use learners are most likely to encounter ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ới)).
Presenting the prosecution's case in court is the usual Vietnamese sense and should precede impeachment ([legal dictionary](https://www.tudienphapluat.com/tong-hop/luan-toi)).
An epicentre is on the Earth's surface, whereas a location beneath the seabed describes the earthquake's focus ([USGS](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/earthquake-hazards/science-earthquakes)).
flags.fix: Tâm chấn của trận động đất nằm ngoài khơi. = The earthquake's epicentre was offshore.

flags.why: Cao minh belongs to literary or elevated usage and would sound affected in ordinary casual speech ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Cao_minh)).
Tượng hình describes writing that represents shapes; chữ tượng hình is the pictogram itself ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Tượng_hình)).
flags.fix: pictographic; representing objects through their shapes

flags.why: The example explains pictographic writing instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Người Ai Cập cổ đại dùng chữ tượng hình. = The ancient Egyptians used pictographic writing.
